key_insight: Single-parameter contractive layers with all-to-all couplings improve quantum neural network expressivity more efficiently than adding conventional brick-wall circuit depth.
engineering_relevance: Contractive layers offer a parameter-efficient design aligned with Rydberg atom arrays for enhancing near-term quantum neural networks.
method: Introduce all-to-all coupling layers governed by one trainable parameter.
Assess accessible target-space dimension per trainable parameter.
Benchmark against deeper brick-wall circuits on observable learning and image recognition.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improved expressivity in observable learning and similar gains in image recognition, but provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Practical gains require validating all-to-all coupling fidelity and robustness to hardware noise, which the abstract does not quantify.
paper_title: Augmenting Quantum Neural Networks with Contractive Layers
